# Game Mechanics Encyclopedia

## Core Mechanics

### Time System

- Real-time progression when player offline
- Tick rate: 1 second (configurable)
- Day/night cycles: 24 real hours = 24 game hours

### Combat System

- Turn-based tactical combat
- Elemental weakness: Fire > Ice > Lightning > Earth > Fire
- Critical hits: 10% base + 5% per combo

### Reputation System

- Faction standing: -100 to +100
- Location reputation: separate per location
- Gossip spreads 3 tiles radius

### Quest System

- Main quest: 1 active at a time
- Side quests: 5 max concurrent
- Procedural generation on trigger
